summary: The school librarian emphasizes the importance of preserving the E-Rate program to ensure access to broadband for students and libraries, arguing that proposals to sunset or limit the program would have a negative impact on students and libraries.

claims.argument: Preserving E-Rate prevents budget cuts to essential services
claims.evidence_quote: While I do understand and agree with the desire to reduce the amount of screen time for students during the school day, the reality is that 21st-Century workers rely on use of the internet for the majority of their work day.
